source_text: Ta is discipulus spiritalis vere recipiens Spiritum Dei, qui ab initio in universis dispositionibus Dei adfuit hominibus, et futura annuntiavit et preesentia ostendit et preeterita enarrat, judicat quidem omnes, ipse autem a nemine judicatur. Nam judicat gentes, creature magis quam Oreatori servientes, et reprobabili mente universam suam operationem in vanum consumentes. Judicat autem etiam Judos, non percipientes verbum libertatis, neque volentes abire liberos, cum habeant preesentem liberatorem ; sed intempestive extra legem servire simulantes nihil indigenti Deo, et Christi adventum, quem propter salutem hominum fecit, non cognoseentes, neque intelligere volentes, quoniam duos adventus ejus omnes annuntiaverunt prophetee: unum quidem, in homo in plaga factus est, sciens ferre imbecillitatem, et in pullo asinee sedens, et reprobatus lapis ab eedificantibus, et sicut ovis ad victimam adductus, et per extensionem manuum dissolvens quidem Amalech; congregans autem dispersos filios a terminis terre in ovile Patris, et recommemoratus mortuorum suorum qui dormierant, et descendens ad eos, uti erueret eos®; secundum autem, in quo super nubes veniet, superducens diem que est sicut clibanus ardens, et percutiens terram verbo oris sui, et spiritu per labia sua interficiens impios, et ventilabrum in manu habens, et’ emundans aream suam, et triticum quidem in horreum comburens autem paleas igne inexstinguibili.
pass_a_gloss: The spiritual disciple indeed truly receiving the Spirit of God, who from the beginning in all the arrangements of God was present to men, and announced future things and showed present things and narrated past things, judges indeed all, ipse autem a nemine judicatur. For he judges the nations, creatures serving the creature more than the Creator, and with a reprobate mind consuming their whole operation in vain. And he judges also the Jews, not perceiving the word of liberty, nor willing to depart free, when they have a present liberator; but simulating to serve outside the law at an unseasonable time, nothing being needed by God, and not knowing the advent of Christ, which he made for the salvation of men, nor willing to understand, since all the prophets announced two advents of him: one indeed, in which he was made man in a plague, knowing to bear infirmity, and sitting on a foal of an ass, and a stone rejected by the builders, and led like a sheep to sacrifice, and dissolving Amalech by the extension of his hands; gathering however the dispersed sons from the ends of the earth into the fold of the Father, and remembering his dead who slept, and descending to them, so that he might rescue them; but the second, in which he will come upon the clouds, bringing a day which is like a burning furnace, and striking the earth with the word of his mouth, and slaying the impious with the spirit through his lips, and having a winnowing fan in his hand, and purifying his floor, and gathering wheat indeed into a barn, but burning chaff with inextinguishable fire.

pass_b_english: The true spiritual disciple, who receives the Spirit of God, has been present from the beginning in all of God's arrangements toward humanity, announcing what is to come, revealing what is present, and explaining what is past. This disciple judges all things, yet is himself judged by no one.
He judges the nations, who serve the creature rather than the Creator, consuming their entire activity in vain with a reprobate mind.

He also judges the Jews, who do not perceive the word of liberty and refuse to go forth free even though they possess a present Liberator. They pretend to serve outside the law at an unseasonable time, as if God needed anything, and they neither know nor wish to understand the advent of Christ, which He accomplished for the salvation of mankind. All the prophets announced His two advents: the first, in which He was made man in affliction, knowing how to bear infirmity, sitting on a foal of a donkey, a stone rejected by the builders, led like a sheep to slaughter, and by the extension of His hands overthrowing Amalek; gathering the scattered children from the ends of the earth into the fold of the Father, remembering His dead who had slept, and descending to them so that He might rescue them. The second advent will come upon the clouds, bringing a day like a burning furnace, striking the earth with the word of His mouth, slaying the impious with the breath of His lips, holding a winnowing fan in His hand, purging His threshing floor, gathering the wheat into the barn, and burning the chaff with unquenchable fire.
